cast.speaker: Rory M
cast.description: Male university student, 20 years old, deep soft low voice, slow dreamy deadpan delivery, posh southern English accent, calm, casual.

cast.speaker: Dev M
cast.description: Male university student, 20 years old, bright higher-pitched voice, quick jittery delivery, strong Mancunian northern English accent, grumpy, casual.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: Do you remember when we played Catten with Bobby last week?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Do you remember when we played Catten with Bobby last week?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: <sarcastic> Yeah. Four hours. He wouldn't let anyone trade for wood.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Yeah. Four hours. He wouldn't let anyone trade for wood.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: <curious> Wha... what do you mean? Like rage? Because yeah, I felt that.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Wha... what do you mean? Like rage? Because yeah, I felt that.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: No, not rage. It's like a warmth, right in my chest.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: No, not rage. It's like a warmth, right in my chest.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: That's acid reflux, mate. That's the Doritos.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: That's acid reflux, mate. That's the Doritos.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: <excited> The way he moves the pieces. The way he builds. That long... long road of his.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The way he moves the pieces. The way he builds. That long... long road of his.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: <curious> I... guess? It was twelve roads long.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I... guess? It was twelve roads long.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: Twelve roads. Exactly, twelve whole roads.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Twelve roads. Exactly, twelve whole roads.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: <exhale> Rory. Mate. It's a board game.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Rory. Mate. It's a board game.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: <excited> He didn't even look at the dice. Just a flick of the wrist. Nine. Of course it was a nine.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: He didn't even look at the dice. Just a flick of the wrist. Nine. Of course it was a nine.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dev M
dialogue_lines.text: <gulp> I thought he was just good at it...
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I thought he was just good at it...

dialogue_lines.speaker: Rory M
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> So... you also find him sexy when he plays Catten?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: So... you also find him sexy when he plays Catten?
